description: A shell script for self-healing connectivity tests, including ping and DNS tests, with corrective actions based on system configuration and network status.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of corrective action setting from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay time before starting ping tests.

methods.name: removehttp
methods.description: Removes HTTP protocol prefix from a URL string.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS ping test and triggers corrective action if enabled and test fails.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs connectivity ping tests to gateway and configured servers for IPv4 and IPv6.
